build.beforeBundleCommand: sh -c 'if [ "$TAURI_ENV_PLATFORM" = "windows" ]; then powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-windows-redist.ps1; fi'

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost https://asset.localhost http: https: data: blob:; media-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost https://asset.localhost http: https: data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://api.github.com https://raw.githubusercontent.com

bundle.shortDescription: Configurable auto clicker with accurate CPS timing.
bundle.longDescription: Performance-focused auto clicker with global hotkeys, optional overlay, and advanced timing. Licensed under GPLv3.
